items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: Phil Johnson and I covered her before and after the Olympics. I wrote the story for the Informer Sentinel, and Phil Johnson wrote the story for the New Orleans item

ctx.x: So you didn't have a specialty?

No. I mean there wasn't anything? No. Well, chemistry, I wasn't good in chemistry, I wasn't good in, what is that other thing, trigonometry. I could do a little algebra, I could read or write real good, but then again, I think I had, I was thinking about the Army, then I had the girls on my mind, then my mother took sick, just a little bit before I went into the Army. And her and my father was beginning to get back together, they developed a beautiful relationship, but they never officially lived in the same…
You know what Cosmo told me?
